title: Vyzh`dra cycle
summary: Advance the temple's serpent cycle and survive Vyzh`dra's leading-target death touch.
overview: Advance the temple's serpent cycle and survive Vyzh`dra's leading-target death touch.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare a tank replacement for each death touch and keep track of the current cycle state.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The controller tracks the designated trigger kills and schedules the appropriate glyphed or runed serpent according to saved progression.
Vyzh`dra the Banished begins his death-touch timer within one to six seconds of engagement, then repeats it every two minutes.
The death touch chooses the leading target, substitutes a pet's owner, and removes listed divine-aura protections.
The Banished form despawns after 25 accumulated minutes out of combat; its death can unlock the Cursed form when the cycle is at the correct stage.

notes: Approval E312. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Full Exiled and serpent branch details still require a dedicated publication pass; this draft documents the reviewed controller and Banished path.
